question: Who is named as composer of Kaulāvalīnirṇaya and which section ends here?
premises: iti marks the conclusion of the section
the composer is named as śrī jñānānanda paramahaṃsa
the section named is the first ullāsa
inference: The colophon attributes the first ullāsa of Kaulāvalīnirṇaya to Śrī Jñānānanda Paramahaṃsa.
uncertainties: exact sandhi and compound boundaries are not expanded beyond the fused token
plain_english: Thus ends the first ullāsa of the Kaulāvalīnirṇaya composed by Śrī Jñānānanda Paramahaṃsa.
